**Claim:** session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w` · branch `claude/issue-8621-retire-declared-divergence-note` · 2026-09-09T01:02Z.

⭐ **PM dispatch**: this seat set the assignee and posts this claim for its dev. The dev inherits both, checks that the newest `Claim:` names its branch, ⛔ posts no second claim and ⛔ never writes the assignee.

### ⭐ The gate — measured before dispatching, because this card has one

> *"Do this **after** objectstack#16920 is MERGED and the pinned `@objectstack/spec` in this repo carries the trimmed refinement."*

**Condition 1 — MET.** `objectstack-ai/objectstack#16920`: `merged: true`, **merged at 2026-09-08T17:54:14Z**, head `ab4d4a2`. Read from GitHub at 01:01Z.

**Condition 2 — ⛔ NOT MEASURED by this seat, and it is the dev's first act.** `/home/user/objectui/node_modules/@objectstack/spec` does not resolve from the primary checkout, so I could not read the installed version from here. ⛔ That is "could not measure", **not** "the pin is stale" — do not inherit either reading. Resolve it in your own worktree (`node_modules/.pnpm`, the package's own `package.json`, or the lockfile pin) and **measure whether the installed spec trims before the emptiness test**.

The card already rules what to do either way: **if the pin predates the fix, the docblock must say _"matches the spec from `<version>`"_ rather than _"matches the installed spec."_** ⛔ Follow that; do not wait, and do not bump the pin — a dependency bump is not this card.

### ⚠️⭐ The card's completion criterion is UNSATISFIABLE as written — do not chase it

> Re-check command: `git grep -n "divergence" -- packages/app-shell/src packages/plugin-designer/src` → **0 hits when done**

**Measured: that can never reach 0.** Those trees carry many *unrelated* divergence notes — `__tests__/spec-symbol-parity.test.ts` (lines 17, 297, 299, 346, 357), `__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` (68, 70, 94), `environment/__tests__/EnvironmentListToolbar.deepLinkArming.test.tsx:16`, `hooks/useActionModal.tsx:174`, and more. ⛔ **None of them is this card's**, and driving that grep to zero would delete other cards' records.

⇒ **Narrow the criterion to this card's subject**: the `reference.trim() !== ''` guard's own docblocks and any pin/test description that names *that* guard as a deliberate divergence. State the narrowed re-check command you used and its reading. ⭐ The card's **positive control is sound and reproduces**: `git grep -c "reference.trim()" -- packages/app-shell/src` → **2** (the card requires ≥ 1).

### Scope, ⛔ narrow

- **Rewrite the two docblocks** — `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `MetadataService.saveFields` / `saveObject` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer`'s `MetadataFieldsPage`: the guard **mirrors the spec's own rule** now, citing the spec refinement in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`. It is no longer a local opinion.
- ⛔ **DO NOT REMOVE THE GUARD.** It still gives the author an editor-time refusal before the publish gate does. Removing it is the one way to fail this card badly.
- Retire the stale "declared divergence" / "stricter than the contract" sentences that name **this** guard, wherever they are — including a changeset's prose if one still carries it.
- **No behaviour change. `Clause-②: no`** — declared by the filer and verified here: the guard is unchanged, so nothing is accepted or refused differently on this side. ⇒ **no carrier**, and there is none on this card. ⛔ If your work turns out to move a published surface anyway, **stop and report**; hanging a carrier is the PM's act, never the dev's.

### Why this card, this round

Maintainer instruction 「并发保持3」; #8318's dev returned, freeing a slot. ⚠️ This is **p3 and it is being taken ahead of higher-priority cards**, all of which are file-blocked — and that is measured, not assumed:

The **#8317** dev is still in flight with a 16-file surface committed locally and **unpushed** (`compare main...claude/issue-8317-…` → ahead 0 on origin; local HEAD `d1a83a60`). It holds **eight** `packages/types/src/zod/*.zod.ts` mirrors plus five `__tests__`. Because nearly every `domain:spec` card lands in `packages/types` and therefore in a mirror, that one dev blocks **#8221** (`objectql.zod.ts`), **#7997** and **#7450** (`views.zod.ts` / `layout.zod.ts`), **#8499**, **#8478**. **#8712** is held by open PR #8646. ⇒ **This card's surface — `packages/app-shell/src` + `packages/plugin-designer/src` — is the only genuinely free one left**, which is why a p3 is going out ahead of them. ⛔ Not a re-grade, ⛔ not a manufactured dispatch.

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first (`/home/user/objectui` and `/home/user/objectstack` are shared checkouts with other agents live in them) · ⛔ never `git stash` · ⛔ never kill by name · ⛔ never mutate anything under `node_modules` (pnpm **hardlinks from the store** — an installed file can carry link count 4 shared with other agents' worktrees, so "my worktree only" is FALSE there) · ⛔ never edit `content/docs/releases/` · draft PR only, ⛔ never enqueue or arm auto-merge · exit codes captured before any pipe · a zero result needs a firing control.

So the docblock says **"matches the spec FROM THE RELEASE CARRYING objectstack#16920"**, ⛔ not "matches the installed spec" — which is exactly what the card ruled for this case. ⛔ And the pin was **not** bumped: a dependency bump is not this card.

2. **The spec-half assertion still reads `success = true` and is labelled a TRIPWIRE** that reddens on the bump — rather than being deleted or weakened to match today.
3. ⭐ **A factual error inside the note being retired was corrected**: the app-shell pin claimed the installed spec was **17.2.0**, and that a green `'   '` therefore measured nothing because an absent target also parsed green. False at the real 17.3.0 pin, where **absent IS refused** — and the corrected prose is now backed by an added absent-target control assertion. ⛔ Fixing prose you happen to be standing next to, rather than leaving it because it is not your card, is the right call when the prose is *about the thing you are editing*.
